titulo: Text me when you get home
alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A room by a window at night. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes waits by the window. A small speech bubble that says home! pops up; the figure's eyes go wide and then happy. The text stays on screen: text me when you get home. (i'm fine. i'm by the window.)
